title: Missed reading alert can't snooze or no sound
body:
Our missed reading alerts don't appear with a snooze option, nor do they appear under the Snooze Alert setting when active. To combat this I unticked ' enable missed reading alert' during a sensor warm up. Now, even though it is re ticked, there's no audible alert for missed readings at all. There is a silent alert though. Other alerts work and snooze as expected. 
We are using this phone as a follower via nightscout. I can provide screen shot of setting if needed.
